scope: Task 0T upstream stock visual control only; this is not a LuBirth opening or production-art approval.

reference.use: Feature-floor reference only; no pixel-level comparison is claimed because the control scene and time of day are intentionally different.

checks.evidence: The converged full composite has discrete foreground billows, deep inter-cloud cavities, and a separate far cloud deck rather than a radial white shell.
The BSM-off diagnostic retains visible cloud geometry while lifting the dark cavities and undercuts seen in full; this isolates native BSM occlusion without a substitute renderer.
The cloud boundaries are eroded and non-uniform at several scales, with no smooth spherical edge. Native telemetry and the fixed high preset both report shapeDetail=true and turbulence=true.
The full/Aerial captures are taken only after nativeFrameCount >= 32 and temporalConverged=true; history-reset-first is separately captured before that convergence gate.

The raw cloud diagnostic exposes the native cloud output without AerialPerspective; AerialPerspective-final restores the atmosphere-composited sky and cloud presentation through the same native composer.
No capture has a continuous white spherical cloud rim. The visible cloud mass is volumetric and broken into weather-driven structures.

reproduction.command: MIRALITH_TAKRAM_PARITY_CAPTURE=1 pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/lubirth-takram-parity-visual.spec.ts --project=desktop --grep 'stock control exposes'

nextGate: Stock opening must be judged independently. A stock opening limitation cannot overturn this upstream control PASS.
